verdict.rationale: Auth0 Actions (its event-triggered rules engine) is only referenced in passing — the MCP server docs mention that AI agents can 'deploy Actions' as part of managing a tenant (auth0-docs-41, auth0-gh-1) — but there is no description of defining triggers, event types, or conditions for automatic execution beyond that one-line mention. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Actions/Rules event triggers (pre-login, post-registration, etc.), examples of an AI-native user authoring such rules, and independent corroboration that this works hands-on via MCP or API.
